note: the 1892 table prints Psalm 180, which does not exist (the Psalter has 150). A misprint; the intended number cannot be known from this source, so it is carried as printed; for the same day 1789 prints Morning 6, 32, 38, Evening 102, 130, 143, which suggests a 3-for-8 misreading -- and if so, a valid-looking number beside it may be misread too
